description: How exposed the country of a currency (RUB, EGP, NGN …) is to EU financial sanctions on the latest day your plan covers: listed persons and entities tied to the country, new listings over 30 and 365 days, the number of sanctions regimes, the latest listing date and an exposure class (none / low / elevated / high), with a ready citation. Counts and dates only, not a screening of a name. Free level: the free currencies, one day behind; Starter and Pro keys of EU Sanctions Exposure by Currency: every currency, today.
